PEOPLE & ENROLLMENT

A name. A face. An identity.

Add a clear, front-facing portrait.

Stored only in this browser

Your first verification

  1. Go to People & enrollment and enroll a consenting person with a name and clear photo.
  2. Open Live verification and enable your camera. Allow camera access in your browser.
  3. Face forward, start the check, and follow the randomized prompt within two seconds.
  4. Use Test lab to label genuine, print, screen, video, and mask attempts. Export the measured results.

This is a local prototype. Active prompts can be defeated by replays or masks; production requires independently evaluated presentation attack detection and a trusted backend.

Camera and models initialize before the timed check. Browser scheduling can exceed two seconds; every attempt records its actual elapsed time.
